dedicated.name: Aris's Earth Dragon Suppression Elixir

why_by_stat.Resilience: Reduces incoming Critical Damage 1%-for-1%, helping Aris survive Critical Hits more easily.

dedicated.story:
"Mother... please forgive the choice I've made."
After a moment's hesitation, Aris roughly tore off the sealing device from around her neck. Coarse yellow smoke billowed from and around her body, and the voice of the Earth Dragon boomed through her head. "You have undone the seal! Soon, your consciousness will slip away, and your body will be mine!"

At that moment, ropes flew in from all directions, binding Aris tightly in place. A woman stepped out from the shadows, holding a yellow flask emblazoned with a yellow dragon emblem. With a swift motion, she shoved the flask's contents into Aris's shouting mouth, calming the billowing yellow aura in an instant. "The Earth Dragon Suppression Elixir worked... Thankfully, it looks like you're still in control of your body after all."

lore: Aris is the leader of Blissful Grief, a guild with all-female membership. To protect her guild from the ravages of war, she forged a pact with an earth dragon. After her mother, the former guild leader, passed, she assumed leadership of the guild. Blissful Grief is the oldest known guild in history and predates even the Terra Kingdom. It began as a traveling troupe whose members honed their combat skills to protect themselves on the road. Aris united the various wandering troupes scattered across the continent, transforming the guild into an even greater force. Lucy, too, had belonged to one of these troupes. Aris deeply trusted and admired Clemyth, who was a close friend of her late mother, and later ventured into the Abyss alongside Clemyth and Zahara in search of the Emerald Tablet. However, they ultimately left the Abyss empty-handed.
